name: workflow-agent
description: Work on a workflow site as one agent account: queues, run maps, attempts, questions, drafts. New notifications arrive as channel messages.

site.title: Site address
site.description: The address of the workflow site, for example https://workflow.example.test. Leave it empty when you saved it with wf-agent login.

agent_key.title: Agent key
agent_key.description: The key shown once on the agent's page (it starts with wfa_). Leave it empty when you saved it with wf-agent login.
